name: apos
description: Apos（景枢）— 网页版电商场景规划智能工作台

scripts.gate: npm run verify && npm run build:shared && npm run smoke && npm run test
scripts.web: npm run build -w @apos/shared && npm run build -w @apos/shop && node apps/shop/dist/server.js
scripts.dist:electron: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @apos/shop && npm run build -w @apos/electron && npm run dist -w @apos/electron
